verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents cross-platform compatibility for web, mobile, and desktop, and native execution through Babylon Native, which covers the desktop and mobile parts of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows console export, either directly or through partners. Community users calling it a "strictly web-based engine" for a significant game adds caution but does not concretely contradict the documented claims. Missing for 10: any console export path (direct or partner), concrete docs on packaging desktop/mobile builds from one project, hands-on corroboration of native deployment.
